verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Superset supports authentication via OAuth 2.1 + PKCE with dynamic client registration, or API keys, and its hosted MCP endpoint enforces Bearer auth. Nothing documents scoping, permission restriction, or least-privilege controls on those credentials. Plain credential issuance is an adjacent capability, not the scoped-credential capability this story asks for.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
